module: Small geometry engine used by the Mesh Spline tool: it computes the derived geometry of a spline (subdivided points, widths, tangents, normals) from its control nodes (Catmull-Rom, free, projected onto the terrain or by raycast), then samples positions along this curve to place meshes. Relies on editor/toolUtilities/geom and util. Called by splineMgr and populate, not by a modder directly.
notes: The output tables (outPositions, outTangents, outNormals) are reused and modified in place to avoid allocations; they are cleared if the spline does not have at least 2 subdivided points.
If spline.isConformToTerrain is true, the nodes are modified in z (terrain height + rayPostFloat, or vertical raycast).

clearDerivedGeometry.desc: Clears the spline's derived tables: divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals and discMap.

updateGeometry.desc: Recomputes the spline's derived geometry. With fewer than 2 nodes, clears the geometry and returns false. If isConformToTerrain: lowers the nodes onto the terrain (terrainOnly) or by vertical raycast, then uses catmullRomConformToTerrain / catmullRomRaycast; otherwise catmullRomFree.

spline.desc: Spline with nodes, widths, nmls, isConformToTerrain, terrainOnly, rayPostFloat.

minimumDivisions.desc: Minimum number of subdivisions per segment (passed to geom).

returns.desc: true if the spline has at least 2 subdivided points after computation.

sample.desc: Samples the spline at regular intervals. With useEvenFit, spacing is a target: an element is locked at both ends and the interior is spaced as uniformly as possible (geom.sampleSplineEvenFit, accounts for isLoop). Otherwise walks at a fixed period (geom.sampleSpline).

spline.desc: Spline with divPoints, tangents, normals, isLoop.

spacing.desc: Period in meters between two positions.

intervalFrame.desc: Computes the local frame (position, tangent, up vector) of the interval between samples index and index+1 (geom.ribbonIntervalFrame).

outUp.desc: Receives the up vector (inferred from code).

previousAcross.desc: Transverse vector of the previous interval, for continuity (inferred from code).

returns.desc: false if positions[index] or positions[index+1] does not exist, otherwise true.
